{{Top}}
[[File:Bossks_mark.svg|thumb|200px|[[Bossk/Legends|Bossk's]] signature.]]
{{Quote|Res Luk Ra'auf.|Bossk|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''"Dosh"''' was short for '''Trandoshan''' and was the official language of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] species from [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]]. It was composed mainly of harsh grunts, hisses and growls, and had a written form that used alphabetic glyphs.

Most Trandoshans were fluent in both Dosh and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], also being literate in both languages.

{{Language-stub}}

==Examples==
*''Ashkrik'' - "Bleeds his enemies dry"<ref name="Campaign Guide">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
*''Davjäan inyameet'' - ("Burning in the blood")<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>
*''Ghrakhowsk'' - A person a Trandoshan owes a life-debt to<ref name="KOTOR 13">[[Knights of the Old Republic 13|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 13]]</ref>
*''Ssoh'' - "Move stealthily"<ref name="Campaign Guide" />
